cash_tip: No one has reported on Sayulita's ATMs this week, but JAHGYRO Gyros takes cards for its evening delivery, so you can save your pesos for elsewhere. When you do withdraw, use a bank ATM, choose 'decline conversion' so you're charged in pesos, take out a larger amount once, and keep small bills for tacos, taxis and the market.
